Approaches to improving the uptake of HIV testing and counseling services were discussed in a study published in Tropical Medicine & International Health in 2007, focusing on the period from 2001 to 2007. 2. The Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS) released a report in 2014 detailing the global response to the AIDS epidemic. 3. A 2009 study in the Journal of Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndromes highlighted the critical role of non-physician clinicians in rapidly expanding HIV care in Mozambique. 4. An evaluation of a task-shifting initiative in Botswana, involving lay counselors, was published in PLoS One in 2013, demonstrating its effectiveness in delivering HIV-related services. 5. The World Health Organization (WHO) published a strategic policy framework in 2012 outlining service delivery approaches for HIV testing and counseling (HTC). 6. A 2010 study in Tropical Medicine & International Health described how universal access to antiretroviral therapy in Thyolo, Malawi, was achieved through task-shifting and decentralization of HIV/AIDS care. 7. A baseline survey conducted in rural northern Ghana, published in the Journal of Biosocial Science in 2007, examined the use of lay counselors to promote community-based voluntary HIV counseling and testing, focusing on community acceptance and stigma. 8. A 2014 presentation by Johnson et al. at the African Society for Laboratory Medicine in Cape Town, South Africa, examined the misclassification of HIV status and false-positive test results. 9. A 2010 case study in BMC Health Services Research by Wolpaw et al. addressed the failure of routine rapid HIV testing and proposed strategies to improve low sensitivity in field settings. 10. A 2015 study in BMC Infectious Diseases evaluated HIV testing algorithms in Ethiopia, emphasizing the role of tie-breaker algorithms and weakly reactive test lines in contributing to high rates of false-positive diagnoses. 11. A 2012 study in BMC Research Notes explored the potential for false-positive HIV test results when using a serial rapid HIV testing algorithm. 12. A 2007 study in the British Medical Journal investigated the limitations of rapid HIV-1 tests during screening for clinical trials in Uganda, focusing on diagnostic test accuracy. 13. A 2011 study in Clinical and Vaccine Immunology assessed the performance of a rapid and simple HIV testing algorithm in a multicenter Phase III microbicide clinical trial. 14. A field evaluation of an HIV rapid test algorithm for rapid diagnosis in Brazil was presented at the HIV Pathogenesis, Treatment, and Prevention conference in Sydney, Australia, in 2007. 15. A Cochrane Database System Review in 2010 examined the effectiveness of home-based HIV voluntary counseling and testing (VCT) in improving the uptake of HIV testing. 16. UNAIDS provides a data analysis tool called AIDSinfo, which was updated in 2015 to support global HIV/AIDS monitoring and reporting. 17. The Government of Burundi published a guide in 2004 on HIV/AIDS/IST counseling, emphasizing national strategies for testing and prevention. 18. Botswana's Ministry of Health released national guidelines for HIV testing and counseling in 2009, outlining best practices for service delivery. 19. Burkina Faso's Ministry of Health published national standards and guidelines for HIV counseling and testing in 2008, focusing on voluntary testing initiatives. 20. Cameroon’s Ministry of Public Health issued national directives in 2014 for the prevention and management of HIV, emphasizing testing and care strategies. 21. The Central African Republic's Ministry of Public Health released a 2010 guide for provider-initiated HIV counseling and testing. 22. Chad's Ministry of Public Health published a training manual in 2011 for HIV/AIDS/IST counseling, focusing on capacity building for healthcare providers. 23. The Union of Comoros released a 2007 guide for managing HIV infection, developed by the National AIDS Control Program. 24. Côte d'Ivoire's Ministry of Health published national standards and guidelines in 2002 for voluntary HIV counseling and testing. 25. The Democratic Republic of Congo's Ministry of Health issued national guidelines in 2004 for voluntary HIV/AIDS counseling and testing. 26. Ethiopia's Federal Ministry of Health published guidelines in 2007 for HIV counseling and testing, emphasizing prevention and control strategies. 27. Ghana's Ministry of Health released national guidelines in 2008 for implementing HIV counseling and testing services. 28. Kenya's Ministry of Public Health and Sanitation published national guidelines in 2010 for HIV testing and counseling. 29. Liberia's Ministry of Health issued integrated guidelines in 2007 for the prevention, testing, care, and treatment of HIV/AIDS. 30. Malawi's Ministry of Health developed a comprehensive HIV testing and counseling training program in 2013. 31. Mozambique's Ministry of Health published a strategic-operational guide in 2008 for implementing health counseling and testing units. 32. Namibia's Ministry of Health and Social Services released national guidelines in 2011 for HIV counseling and testing. 33. Nigeria's Federal Ministry of Health issued national guidelines in 2011 for HIV counseling and testing. 34. Rwanda's Ministry of Health published national guidelines in 2013 for the prevention and management of HIV, STIs, and other bloodborne infections. 35. Sierra Leone's Ministry of Health and Sanitation released guidelines in 2003 for voluntary confidential HIV counseling and testing. 36. South Africa's Department of Health published HIV counseling and testing policy guidelines in 2011. 37. Swaziland's Ministry of Health released the HTC Program Annual Report in 2012, summarizing progress and challenges in HIV testing and counseling. 38. Tanzania's Ministry of Health issued national guidelines in 2012 for managing HIV and AIDS. 39. Uganda's Ministry of Health published national implementation guidelines in 2010 for HIV counseling and testing. 40. Zambia's Ministry of Health released national guidelines in 2006 for HIV counseling and testing. 41. Zimbabwe's Ministry of Health and Child Care published national guidelines in 2014 for HIV testing and counseling services. 42. Brazil's Department of Health issued a technical manual in 2014 for diagnosing HIV infection. 43. Canada's Public Health Agency published a guide in 2012 for HIV screening and testing. 44. Trinidad and Tobago's Ministry of Health released a national HIV testing and counseling policy in 2012. 45. Afghanistan's Ministry of Public Health published national guidelines in 2013 for HIV testing and counseling services. 46. Egypt's Ministry of Health issued national guidelines in 2004 for voluntary HIV counseling and testing. 47. Libya published guidelines in 2010 for HIV voluntary counseling and testing services. 48. Morocco provided HIV testing information in 2014 through Dr. Mehdi Karkouri. 49. Pakistan's Ministry of Health released HIV voluntary counseling and testing guidelines in 2010. 50. Somalia's Federal Ministry of Health published guidelines in 2011 for HIV testing and counseling in healthcare settings. 51. Sudan's Ministry of Health issued guidelines in 2008 for voluntary HIV counseling and testing. 52. Syria provided HIV testing information in 2014 through WHO EMRO contact Joumanna Hermez. 53. Tunisia's Ministry of Health published a national HIV testing strategy in 2014. 54. Ukraine's Ministry of Health issued a protocol in 2005 for voluntary HIV counseling and testing. 55. England's Public Health Agency published standards in 2014 for anti-HIV screening in microbiology investigations. 56. India's Ministry of Health released national guidelines in 2007 for HIV testing and counseling. 57. Indonesia's Ministry of Health published guidelines in 2014 for HIV counseling and testing. 58. Nepal's Ministry of Health issued national guidelines in 2007 for voluntary HIV/AIDS counseling and testing. 59. Australia's Department of Health published the National HIV Testing Policy in 2014. 60. Cambodia's Ministry of Health released standard operating procedures in 2012 for HIV testing and counseling. 61. China's Center for Disease Control and Prevention issued national guidelines in 2009 for HIV/AIDS detection. 62. Papua New Guinea's Ministry of Health published national guidelines in 2010 for HIV counseling and testing. 63. The Philippines' Department of Health issued an administrative order in 2010 for HIV counseling and testing in community and healthcare settings. 64. Vietnam's Ministry of Health published national HIV diagnostic testing methods in 2014. 65. WHO reminded national programs in 2014 to retest all newly diagnosed individuals with HIV to ensure accurate diagnosis.
